wybie_line_a.text: Ooh, let me guess, you're from Texas or Utah, someplace dried out and barren, right?
I heard about water witching before, but it doesn't make sense.
I mean, it's just an ordinary branch.
And I don't like being stalked, not by psycho nerds or their cats!
He's not really my cat. He's kind of feral. You know, wild.
Of course, I do feed him every night, and sometimes he'll come in my window and bring me little dead things.

wybie_line_b.text: Hey, Jonesy, look what I found in Grandma's trunk. You look familiar? Wybie.
Well, great to meet a Michigan water witch.
But I'd wear gloves next time.
Because that dowsing rod of yours, it's poison oak.

other_mother_intro.text: What are you doing here in the middle of the night?
You're just in time for supper, dear.
Now go tell your other father that supper's ready.

other_father_intro.text: Want to hear my new song?

other_father_dinners_ready.text: I, um, sorry, but she said to tell you the food's ready.
Mmm, who's starving? Raise your hand.

other_father_golden_chicken_breast.text: We give our thanks and ask to bless our mother's golden chicken breast.

other_parents_waiting.text: We've been waiting for you, Coraline.
Yep, wasn't the same here without you, kiddo.

other_mother_visit_again.text: It's time for bedtime, dear, but promise you'll visit us again every night and I'll have special treats ready for you.

other_mother_supper_1.text: Well here comes the gravy train. Choo-choo!

other_mother_supper_2.text: Another roll? Sweet peas? Corn on the cob.

other_father_song.text: Make it up a song about Coraline. She's a peach, she's a doll, she's a pal of mine. She's as cute as a button in the eyes of everyone who ever laid their eyes on Coraline.
When she comes around exploring home and I will never ever make it boring, our eyes will be on Coraline.

dad_death.text: No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no!

wybie_visit_a.text: Ow! I wasn't stalking you. We're hunting banana slugs.

wybie_visit_b.text: So, that doll, did you make it look like me?
Oh, no. I found it that way. It's older than Grandma. Old as this house, probably.
Come on. Blue hair, my swampers, and raincoat?

wybie_visit_d.text: Huh? I meant my parents. They don't listen to me either.

wybie_visit_j.text: You know, I've never been inside the Pink Palace. Grandma'd kill me. Thinks it's dangerous or something.
Well, she had a twin sister. When they were kids, Grandma's sister disappeared. She says she was stolen. I don't know. Maybe she just ran away.

bobinsky_visit_a.text: Famous Jumping Mouse Circus not ready.
Oh, uh, I, uh, brought this for you.

bobinsky_visit_c.text: Very clever. Using this mix-up to sneak my home and peek at mooshkas.

bobinsky_visit_d.text: And I am the amazing Bobinsky.
But you, call me Mr. B.
Because amazing, I already know that I am.

bobinsky_visit_e.text: You see, Caroline, the problem is my new songs go oompa, oompa, but the jumping mice play only toodle-toot like that.
It's nice, but not so much amazing.
So now I switch to stronger cheese and soon watch out.

bobinsky_visit_f.text: Here, have beet, make you strong.

bobinsky_visit_j.text: The mice asked me to give you a message. They are saying, do not go through little door. Do you know such a thing? The one behind the wallpaper? But it's all bricked up.

bobinsky_visit_k.text: Bah, so sorry. It's nothing. Sometimes the mice are a little mixed up.
They even get your name wrong, you know. They call you Coraline instead of Caroline.
Not Caroline at all. Maybe I work them too hard.

tea_visit_a.text: Oh, cease your infernal yapping. Oh, how nice to see you, Caroline. Would you like to come in? We're playing cards.

tea_visit_c.text: April, I think you're being followed.
It's the new neighbour, Miriam, Caroline.
She'll be having the oolong tea.
Oh, I don't know. I'm sure she'd prefer jasmine.

tea_visit_d.text: I'll read them, if you like.
Oh, your tea leaves, dear. They'll tell me your future.

tea_visit_e.text: No, not all of it, not all of it. That's right. Now hand it over.

tea_visit_f.text: Oh, oh, Caroline, Caroline, Caroline, Caroline, you are in terrible danger.

tea_visit_g.text: Oh, give me that cup, April. Your eyes are going.
My eyes? You're blind as a bat.
Oh, now, um, well, not to worry, child. It's good news.
There's a tall, handsome beast in your future.
Miriam, oh, really, you're holding it wrong.
See? Danger. I see a very peculiar hand.

tea_visit_h.text: Giraffes don't just fall from the sky, Miriam.

tea_visit_j.text: Never wear green in your dressing room.

wybie_adventure_intro.text: I thought you'd like him more if he spoke a little less. So I fixed him.
So he can't talk at all?
Now run along, you two, and have fun.

theatre_a.text: Ready to break a leg, Miriam!
Our lives for the theatre, April.

theatre_e.text: What a piece of work is man, how noble in reason, how infinite in faculty, in form and moving, how express and admirable, in action like an angel, in apprehension, how like a god.

theatre_f.text: The beauty of the world. The paragon of animals.

theatre_meet_parents.text: They swooped down and pulled me right out of my seat.
Spink and Forcible, only they weren't old ladies.
But then I was flying through the air and it was, oh, it was magic.

mouse_circus_invite.text: Coraline, Mr. Bobinsky has invited you to come see the jumping mice perform after dinner.
Your father and I will clean up while you and your friend head upstairs.

mouse_circus_intro.text: Ladies and gentlemen, for to tickle your eyes and ears, and making hearts to touch, I, Sergei Alexander Bobinsky, am introducing my astonishing, stupendulous, and amazing, jumping mouse circus.

mouse_circus_end.text: We loved it, Mr. B. It was so...so...amazing!
Very, very thank you, lady and gentleman.
You are very welcome any time you like.
You and also your good friend there.

missing_parents_tea_a.text: Coraline says her parents have vanished quite completely.

missing_parents_tea_b.text: What? We've waited months for those tickets.
With your gammy legs, it's nearly two miles to the theatre.

missing_parents_tea_c.text: Oh yes, your missing parents. We know just what you need.

missing_parents_tea_e.text: How is 100-year-old candy going to help?

missing_parents_tea_i.text: Well, it might help. They're good for bad things sometimes.
No, they're good for lost things.

missing_parents_cat_a.text: Hello. Do you know where Mom and Dad are?

missing_parents_cat_f.text: They're not coming back, are they? Mom and Dad. Not on their own. Only one thing to do.

parent_rescue_a.text: You know you're walking right into her trap.
I have to go back. They are my parents.
Challenge her, then. She may not play fair, but she won't refuse.
She's got a thing for games.

parent_rescue_b.text: Coraline? Mom? Coraline, you came back for us. Mom!

parent_rescue_c.text: Darling, why would you run away from me?

parent_rescue_d.text: Gosh, I have no idea where your old parents are.
Perhaps they've grown bored of you and run away to France.
They weren't bored of me. You stole them!

parent_rescue_e.text: Why don't you have your own key?

parent_rescue_g.text: The garden squash need tending, don't you think, pumpkin?

parent_rescue_j.text: What kind of game would it be? An exploring game. A finding things game.

parent_rescue_k.text: And what is it you'd be finding, Coraline?
And, and the eyes of the ghost children.

parent_rescue_l.text: What if you don't find them?
If I lose, I'll stay here with you forever and let you love me.
And I'll let you sew buttons into my eyes.
Hmm. And if you somehow win this game?
Then you let me go. You let everyone go. My real father and mother, the dead children, everyone you've trapped here.
Not till you give me a clue.
In each of three wonders I've made just for you,
a ghost's eye is lost in plain sight.

cocoa_beetles_a.text: They say even the proudest spirit can be broken with love.

cocoa_beetles_b.text: Of course, chocolate never hurts. Like what? They're cocoa beetles from Zanzibar.

cocoa_beetles_c.text: I want to be with my real mom and dad. I want you to let me go.

cocoa_beetles_d.text: Is that any way to talk to your mother?

cocoa_beetles_e.text: No! I'll give you to the count of three.

mirror_prison_a.text: You may come out when you've learned to be a loving daughter.

mirror_prison_c.text: Hush, and shush, for the Beldam might be listening.
You, you mean the Other Mother?

mirror_prison_d.text: Don't remember our names, but I remember my true mommy.
She spied on our lives through the little doll's eyes.
And saw that we weren't happy.
So she lured us away with treasures and treats and games to play.
Gave all that we asked, yet we still wanted more.
So we let her sew the buttons.
She said that she loved us.
But she locked us here and ate up our lives.

mirror_prison_e.text: Well, she can't keep me in the dark forever. Not if she wants to win my love. Beating her is my only chance.
Perhaps if you do win your escape, you could find our eyes.
Find our eyes, Mistress, and our souls will be freed.

first_escape_b.text: What? Did she do this to you?

first_escape_e.text: Come on, she'll hurt you again.

first_escape_g.text: Coraline, how dare you disobey your mother!

missing_parents_a.text: I'm home! Anybody here? Hello? Hello? Hello? Real Dad? Real Mom?

missing_parents_b.text: Huh? Yeah. Um, so, you know that old doll I gave you? Um, my grandma's real mad. Says it was her sister's. The one that disappeared.
You stole that doll, didn't you?
Well, it looked just like you. And I figured...
It used to look like this pioneer girl. Then Huck Finn Junior Then it was this little rascal's chick with all these ribbons and braids and...
I think I just met her.

missing_parents_c.text: Not in a million years, but it wouldn't matter.
She can't escape without her eyes.
So, I really need to get that door.
Great. I'd love to get rid of it.

missing_parents_d.text: Where are you hiding, you little monster?
The doll's your spy. It's how she watches you. Finds out what's wrong with your life.
The doll is my grandma's spy.
No, the Other Mother. She's got this whole world where everything's better.
The food, the garden, the neighbors. But it's all a trap.
Yeah, I think I heard someone calling me, Jonesy.
I'll just tell Grandma that she couldn't find the doll.

missing_parents_e.text: You are not listening to me!

missing_parents_g.text: Are you crazy? You're the jerkwad that gave me the doll!

rescue_mantis_intro.text: Sorry. So sorry, Mother making me. Don't wanna hurt you.

rescue_bobinsky_b.text: Is this what you're looking for?

rescue_bobinsky_c.text: You think winning game is good thing?

rescue_bobinsky_d.text: You'll just go home and be bored and neglected, same as always.
We will listen to you and laugh with you.

rescue_bobinsky_e.text: If you stay here, you can have whatever you want, Vsegda. Always.
You don't get it, do you?
You're just a copy she made of the real Mr. B.

finale_a.text: So, you're back, and you brought Vermin with you?

finale_b.text: You have a very funny way of showing it.

finale_c.text: So, where are they, the Ghost Eyes?

finale_d.text: Hold on. We aren't finished yet, are we?
No, I suppose not. After all, you still need to find your old parents, don't you?

finale_g.text: I already know where you've hidden them.

finale_j.text: Go on. Open it. You'll be there, all right.

finale_k.text: You're wrong, Coraline. They aren't there.

finale_q.text: No! Where are you? You selfish brat!

finale_s.text: Don't leave me! Don't leave me! I'll die without you!

reunion_a.text: Mom! Dad, I missed you so much.
Missed us? Oh, no, you broke my favorite snow globe.
I didn't break it. It must have broke when you escaped.
Coraline, I asked you to count all the windows, not put your knee through them.
Well, get yourself cleaned up. We're going out tonight.
We got a lot to celebrate.
You're talking about your garden catalog?

reunion_b.text: But look at the snow on your clothes.

farewell_a.text: Oh. Hello again. You still mad? I'm really sorry I threw you at her. The Other Mother. It was all I could think of.

farewell_b.text: I think it's time, don't you? To set them free?

farewell_c.text: It's a fine, fine thing you did for us, Miss.
Well, I'm glad it's finally over.
It is over and done with for us.
But how? I locked the door.
It's the key, Miss. There's only one, and the Beldam will find it.

theatre_opening_d.text: I'm known as the siren of all seven seas, the breaker of hearts by the bay.
So if you go swimming with bow-legged women, I might steal your weak heart away.

theatre_opening_f.text: A big-bottomed sea witch may bob through the waves and hope to lead sailors astray,
but a true ocean goddess must fill out a bodice to present an alluring display.

theatre_opening_g.text: Beware of old oysters too large in the chest. Let's banish them from the buffet. I'm far more nutritious.

crawling_hand_f.text: I'm really sorry I didn't believe you about all this evil stuff, Coraline.
Why did you change your mind?
Well, Grandma showed me this picture after I called you crazy.

crawling_hand_g.text: It's her and her sister, before she disappeared.

crawling_hand_i.text: Oh, man. What am I going to tell her?
Just bring her by the house tomorrow. We can tell her together.

black_is_traditional_a.text: You do like it here, don't you, Coraline?

black_is_traditional_b.text: You could stay here forever, if you want to.
Sure, we'll sing and play games, and Mother will cook your favorite meals.
There's one tiny little thing we need to do.

black_is_traditional_d.text: Black is traditional, but if you'd prefer

black_is_traditional_g.text: Though you might make me jealous.

black_is_traditional_h.text: No way! You're not sewing buttons in my eyes!

black_is_traditional_i.text: Oh, but we need a yes if you want to stay here.

black_is_traditional_j.text: So sharp you won't feel a thing.

black_is_traditional_k.text: There now. It's your decision, darling. We only want what's best for you.

black_is_traditional_l.text: I'm going to bed. Right now.
I just need to sleep on things.
Well, of course you do, darling. I'll be happy to tuck you in.
Oh, no thanks. You've done so much already.
We aren't worried at all, darling.
Soon you'll see things our way.

black_is_traditional_m.text: What's wrong, Coraline? Don't you want to play?
Yeah, I want a hug your face.
You want to stay, don't you?
I'm going home tonight, robots, and I won't be back.

black_is_traditional_p.text: Hey, you! Where's the other mother? I want to go home.
All will be swell soon as mother's refreshed. Her strength is ours.

black_is_traditional_q.text: Sir, mustn't talk when Mother's not here.
If you won't even talk to me, I'm going to find the Other Wybie.

black_is_traditional_r.text: No point. He pulled a long face, and Mother didn't like him.

cat_encounter_a.text: No, I'm not the other anything. I'm me. I've been coming here for a while.

cat_encounter_b.text: It's a game we play. She hates cats and tries to keep me out. But she can't, of course.

cat_encounter_c.text: I come and go as I please.
Not like any mother I've ever known.
What do you mean? She's amazing.

cat_encounter_d.text: You probably think this world is a dream come true, but you're wrong.
The Other Wybie told me so.
We cats, however, have far superior senses than humans and can see and smell and...

cat_encounter_e.text: Huh? Something's wrong. Shouldn't the old well be here?
Nothing out here. It's the empty part of this world. She only made what she knew would impress you.
But why? Why does she want me?
She wants something to love, I think. Something that isn't her. Or maybe she just loves something to eat.
Eat? That's ridiculous. Mothers don't eat daughters.
I don't know. How do you taste?

cat_encounter_f.text: Huh? But, how can you walk away from something and still come back to it?

cat_encounter_h.text: Stop! He's one of the circus mice!

cat_encounter_i.text: I don't like rats at the best of times, but this one was sounding an alarm.

magic_garden_hop_on.text: Hop on, kiddo. I want to show you something.

magic_garden_mother_said.text: I can't believe you did this.
Mother said you'd like it, [unclear] she knows you like the back of her hand.

mirror_prison_e_accepted.text: Perhaps if you do win your escape, you could find our eyes.
Find our eyes, Mistress, and our souls will be freed.
